responsibility: Implements RTL-specific diagnostics and fatal error helpers. It finds source locations for inline-asm RTL from ASM_OPERANDS, reports warnings and errors against those locations, and provides the fatal_insn and fatal_insn_not_found backends that dump the offending RTL and abort when an insn is unrecognizable or violates its constraints.
same_name_distinction: Implements RTL diagnostic behavior, including locating inline-asm source positions and the fatal_insn backends that print offending RTL and abort; unlike gcc/rtl-error.h, it is the diagnostic implementation file rather than the small public declaration header.
